security_audit.summary: All static external command alerts are false positives caused by markdown backticks, code fences, and example paths in SKILL.md. The path traversal and network reconnaissance alerts are also false positives: they are relative documentation links and a progress heading, not dangerous behavior. No prompt injection or malicious intent was found.

content.user_title: Create Conductor Tracks With Specs and Plans
content.value_statement: New engineering work often starts without clear scope or acceptance criteria. This skill gathers inputs and produces Conductor specs, plans, metadata, and track links.
actual_capabilities: Checks for required Conductor context files before creating a track.
Classifies work as feature, bug, chore, or refactor.
Asks focused questions for scope, dependencies, risks, and acceptance criteria.
Drafts a spec.md document and waits for user approval.
Drafts a phased plan.md with verification tasks.
Creates track metadata, index links, and registry updates.
limitations: Requires an existing Conductor directory and context files.
Does not implement the track after planning is complete.
Relies on user review before final track creation.
Only covers Conductor documented track structure.

use_cases.title: Feature Planning
use_cases.description: Product engineers can turn a feature idea into a reviewed spec and phased plan.

use_cases.title: Bug Fix Intake
use_cases.description: Support engineers can capture reproduction steps, expected behavior, affected areas, and a repair plan.

use_cases.title: Refactor Coordination
use_cases.description: Technical leads can document motivation, risks, success criteria, and verification work before refactoring.

prompt_templates.title: Start a Feature Track
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a new feature track for adding saved searches to the dashboard.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Bug Fix
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a bug track for login redirects failing after password reset. Ask me one question at a time.

prompt_templates.title: Scope a Refactor
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a refactor track for separating billing logic from account settings. Include risk questions and verification steps.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Constrained Migration Track
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a chore track for migrating analytics events. Use Conductor context, capture dependencies, define out-of-scope work, and produce a phased plan.

output_examples.input: Create a feature track for team-level notification preferences.
output: A classified feature track with summary, user story, acceptance criteria, dependencies, and scope boundaries.
A phased implementation plan with verification after each phase.
A completion note that lists the generated Conductor files.

output_examples.input: Create a bug track for export jobs timing out.
output_examples.output: A bug-focused spec covering reproduction steps, expected behavior, actual behavior, affected areas, and a repair plan.

output_examples.input: Create a refactor track for simplifying checkout state management.
output: A refactor track that records motivation, success criteria, risks, and phased implementation work.
A metadata record and track index entry for Conductor navigation.

best_practices: Review generated spec and plan text before creating files.
Keep each track focused on one feature, bug, chore, or refactor.
Use acceptance criteria and verification tasks that can be checked independently.
anti_patterns: Starting a track before Conductor context files exist.
Combining unrelated feature and refactor work in one track.
Skipping the review steps and accepting incomplete scope.

faq.question: What does this skill create?
faq.answer: It creates a Conductor track with a specification, phased plan, metadata, index page, and registry updates.

faq.question: Does it write application code?
faq.answer: No. It plans work and creates tracking documents; implementation is handled by other workflows.

faq.question: Can it handle bugs?
faq.answer: Yes. It asks for reproduction steps, expected behavior, actual behavior, affected areas, and optional root cause notes.

faq.question: Does it require Conductor setup?
faq.answer: Yes. It expects conductor/product.md, conductor/tech-stack.md, and conductor/workflow.md to exist.

faq.question: How does it choose a track ID?
faq.answer: It builds a short name from the task summary, adds the current date, and checks for collisions.

faq.question: Can I edit the generated spec or plan?
faq.answer: Yes. The workflow asks for review before final track creation.
